Top 5 Must-Do Weekend Activities in St. Louis

Rebekah Coste

    ☀️Weekend Top 5☀️

    Presented by: Foss Swim School

    Check out these five family friendly activities happening!

     

    ✅ Touch-A-Truck at Jefferson Barracks
    When: August 14th 10:00 am –  1:00 pm
    Where: 410 Bagby St., St. Louis, MO 63125
    Cost: FREE

    ✅ Movie Night in Bluebird Park- How to Train Your Dragon
    When: August 14th 7:00 pm
    Where: 225 Kiefer Creek Rd., Ellisville, MO 63021
    Cost: FREE

    ✅ Found & Formed x The Glendale Grind
    When: August 15th 1:00-3:00pm
    Where: 421 N Sappington Rd, Kirkwood, MO 63122
    Cost: $40 Adults, $20 Kids (Reserve online!)

    ✅ CWE Jazz and Blues Festival
    When: August 15th 1:00 to 7:00pm
    Where: Euclid & Laclede Avenue
    Cost: FREE

    ✅ Gateway Dragon Boat Festival
    When: August 15th  8:25 am –  2:00 pm
    Where: 13725 Marine Ave.,Maryland Heights, MO 63043
    Cost: FREE

      Rebekah Coste
      https://stlouismom.com/
      Rebekah is the founder and owner of St. Louis Mom. Born and raised in St. Louis, she loves the city for its rich history and small-town feel, Cardinals baseball, and toasted ravioli! After living and working overseas for three years, she is thrilled to be home in St. Louis. She is a full-time stay at home mom to three beautiful daughters and a son and wife to her husband Jean-Christophe. They reside in Kirkwood and own Scarlett's Wine bar. Her hope for St. Louis Mom is that it will be a tool for building community between mothers and a space where shared motherhood experience can converge!
